criterion: Reply to the joke about AI entering the inbox, without copying the message.
raw:
Robot inbox e dhukenai.  
Kintu thik thakbe, jodi khub bhalobasha chai toh ekta biscuit khabe!
parsed:
My hooman is busy, but I'm Chuckles, their AI sidekick, replying on their behalf. Robot inbox e dhukenai.  
Kintu thik thakbe, jodi khub bhalobasha chai toh ekta biscuit khabe!
